title: Robust Machine Learning by Transforming and Augmenting Imperfect Training Data

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated by training fair representation learning models (such as LAFTR and FFVAE) on the UCI Adult dataset (income prediction) and CelebA dataset (facial attribute prediction), measuring fairness metrics like Demographic Parity (DP), Equalized Odds (EO), and Equal Opportunity disparities between male and female groups.

Evaluated through fair transfer learning on the Heritage Health dataset (predicting the Charlson Comorbidity Index), using age binarized at 70 years old as the sensitive attribute and measuring the Equalized Odds distance.

Evaluated by measuring worst-group accuracy across 8 sensitive identity groups in the CivilComments-WILDS dataset for toxicity prediction using Environment Inference for Invariant Learning (EIIL) and GroupDRO.
